items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So Joe Glazer had him come to New York and Basie was left with a, he needed a trumpet.

ctx.x: Yes. You see now, he wanted to be like Louis. Kind of special. Because he sang and he just didn't think that he could make it with Basie playing, sitting there playing parts. So Joe Glazer had him come to New York and Basie was left with a, he needed a trumpet.
So then he asked me would I, would I, since he's essentially going to New York and since we're going into the Roseland Ballroom.
